summary: Large gardens car park just south-west; no homes close, plenty of cars.
reasons: Mapped car park 34 m away, many cars
Pin itself is bush, so car park judged

best_section.where: Western edge of the sealed gardens car park below the pin

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by garden bush; nearest homes are over 90 m north-east beyond trees. Cafe and studio are non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with marked bays off the gardens road; room for a van. Pin itself has no track.
drivers.traffic: Mt Coot-tha Road passes 20 m north behind trees; visitor traffic by day.
drivers.convention: Busy visitor car park, so a van does not stand out; overnight rules unknown.

flags: Pin is in bush and steep, 7% mean; car park is on flatter ground
Slope for the car park not sampled
Waterway mapped at the pin; low ground about 26 m
Gardens hours or overnight signs not visible
sun_shade: Car park is open to sun with tree shade along the north and east edges.
cannot_judge: Gardens opening hours and overnight rules
